steps.content: MBCC Chief's Office
Your aching body wakes you up, and in your grogginess, you seem to really catch sight of a "candy house."

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Boss! You're awake!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Dudu?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Well, I don't know what you dreamt about last night, but you kept kicking the blanket, so I had to stay up all night watching over you.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: But that's not important. Look over here, boss! Here!
Dudu, with dark circles under her eyes from another sleepless night, gestures towards something...
It's a candy house ornament on the table, decorated with colorful pieces of candy that appear dazzling under the glow of the vibrant lights.
Dudu claps her hands, a hint of pride in her tone.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: This is the candy house I promised to make for you! What do you think? Isn't it just so impressive and gorgeous?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eh...? Didn't you say you needed 720 pieces of candy to build a super big candy house?
Dudu appears momentarily perplexed, and you both exchange glances.
After a brief moment of silence, Dudu suddenly comprehends the situation and then appears slightly embarrassed, scratching her head.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: W-well... I must have made a mistake after all those revisions. The paper was a mess, and I might have wrote an extra zero...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: No wonder you said no! Hahaha...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Now, it all makes sense.
You gently pick up the candy house, glued together in a haphazard manner. Despite the rough craftsmanship, Dudu has meticulously carved out the doors, windows, and chimney with a small knife.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you, Dudu.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I love it.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Boss, check this!
As Dudu opens the door to the candy house, the bell on it jingles.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: It's all made of candy! I wanted to make it feel like a real home...
You see a tiny Dudu witch in a hood, a little white ghost, and a little you inside the candy house.
...Isn't this the dream from last night?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did you do all of this last night after I fell asleep? Right here?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Yeah. What do you think? Aren't they so cute?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: These are characters from the picture book, like the witch and the little ghost... I designed the witch to resemble myself, hehe... Doesn't it look very like me?
...You must have glimpsed the little ornaments before fully falling asleep and dreamt about them... You smile, recalling the peculiar dream.
Dudu continues to talk excitedly.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: So, boss, whenever you open the door of the candy house and see us, it'll lift your spirits.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Speaking of which, did you have a good dream last night?

options: I can't remember, but I'm still tired.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Uh... yes... and no...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Actually, I guess I did.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I thought you didn't have any candy. Where did you get these from?
Dudu seems to be dodging your gaze.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Um... Well...
Suddenly, a commotion erupts from the end of the corridor, with one voice audibly gritting her teeth, closely followed by another voice.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Where is the candy I saved from last year...? Did any of you see my candy?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Wait, mine is gone, too!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Ahaha, boss, I got a thing to do somewhere else, so I'll be off!

She scurries out of your room. You gaze down at the candy house, its colorful lights casting a soft glow on your face. The sweet scent wafts through the room, and despite the candy showing signs of melting, you feel reluctant to put it down.
Dudu doesn't go far before poking her head back in through the open door, beaming at you.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: By the way...!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Boss, not just tonight, but I hope you have sweet dreams every night from now on!
